notes: `serviceName` is `stlquest`, so browser logs and metrics report as `stlquest-web`, with the release as `serviceVersion`.

PostHog starts while the first enabled `PostHogIntegration` renders instead of when `src/client/posthog.tsx` loads, and `PostHogIntegration` takes `enabled`, because each deployment can turn telemetry off in its settings and the published image carries the project token; it still starts before any child's effect runs.
`PostHogIntegration` takes the translated `fallback` the root route renders.

`postHogOptions` adds the application's `before_send` filters (expected storage rejections, duplicate server function exceptions, opaque cross-origin script errors), turns off console error capture, masks all text and element attributes, and blocks `.ph-no-capture` in replay, because workspaces hold names, filenames, and notes.

The Docker build maps the existing repository variables `POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID` and `POSTHOG_HOST` and secret `POSTHOG_API_KEY` onto the `POSTHOG_CLI_*` names in `.github/workflows/docker.yml`, which is this application's deploy workflow, and keeps the `GITHUB_*` build arguments that name the uploaded release.
`vitest.config.ts` defines `__APP_VERSION__`, which `postHogOptions` reads.

`src/server/app.ts` keeps the application's asynchronous composition root: `app()` returns a promise, because opening the repository, distributed coordination, and storage recovery are asynchronous, and the instance reconciles workflow changes and closes its resources in its own order. It lives on `globalThis` under `Symbol.for('stlquest.app')`.

`src/server/origins.ts` reads `BETTER_AUTH_URL` and `BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS` instead of `APP_URL`, the names self-hosted deployments already set, and always accepts the forwarded origin instead of requiring `TRUST_PROXY`, because self-hosted installs run behind whatever proxy the operator chose and rejecting it would break every mutation there.
`isSameOriginRequest` takes `allowReferer`, which the tus `HEAD` check uses because browsers send no `Origin` on it.
`src/server/middleware.ts` drops `canonicalHost`: a self-hosted install is reached by LAN names and addresses as well as `BETTER_AUTH_URL`, and redirecting those would lock operators out.
The stale server function message is the application's English copy, which the browser matches to show the translated message.
`src/server/contentSecurityPolicy.ts` adds `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` for meshoptimizer, `blob:` workers and images, and the Gravatar, Discord, and Google avatar hosts.
`/api/**` responses keep `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` from a Nitro route rule in `vite.config.ts`.
`rpc` and `mutationRpc` run inside the request's locale and log failures through the application's pino logger.

`healthResponse` logs a failed check as a warning through the pino logger, so a restart loop does not report an exception per probe; the health route checks the repository and upload staging and maps failures to `service_unavailable`.
The Query client keeps `staleTime: 0`, because realtime invalidation refetches every active query, and shows mutation failures as toasts.
Chunk recovery keeps the `stlquest:chunk-reload` storage key and reveals the application's translated `chunk-load-failure` notice in `UpdateNotices`.

The root route keeps the document in `component`, because `<html lang>` follows the session's locale from a suspense query, and keeps its own head tags, theme and translation guard scripts, and providers.
The router keeps the application's `RouteError` and translated not-found page, and leaves scroll restoration off.
`src/styles.css` imports `tw-animate-css` and the application's theme stylesheets after Tailwind.
`vite.config.ts` keeps the development `/api` image workaround, the `__APP_VERSION__` define, and resolves the `@/*` alias with `resolve.tsconfigPaths`.
`AGENTS.md` is a symlink to `CLAUDE.md`, which keeps the application's agent guide and carries the recipe paragraph under **Recipes**.
`tsconfig.json` keeps `target` ES2022, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: false`, `resolveJsonModule`, and the `@/*` path alias, because the codebase predates the strict preset and indexes arrays throughout.

`.oxlintrc.json` turns off `typescript/no-unnecessary-type-assertion` in tests, because recipe tests assert indexes with `!` and the application's `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: false` makes those assertions redundant.
`.oxlintrc.json` also extends the `domain.json` preset, which keeps `src/core` free of IO and framework imports, and turns off the rules the codebase does not follow.
`.oxfmtrc.json` keeps its schema and ignores generated catalogs, deploy templates, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
`vitest.config.ts` resolves the `@` alias, runs files one at a time in forks because tests share the `globalThis` app singleton and SQLite state, and keeps the node environment.

`check` runs `check:ci` and then the tests, and `check:ci` keeps the application's extra gates: Changesets, Markdown links, both Drizzle dialects, the equipment catalogs, Unraid metadata, and the backup CLI.
`pnpm-workspace.yaml` keeps the application's overrides and peer rules, and allows builds for `argon2` and `workerd`, which it installs.
